## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and link related issues (`Closes #...`).

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] E2E run, or prerequisites and reason for skipping documented

## Change review

- [ ] No secrets, private document content, email addresses, or user IDs are logged or committed
- [ ] External inputs are validated with zod
- [ ] Database migrations and RLS changes are included and documented, or not applicable
- [ ] RAG behavior, prompts, models, embeddings, and evaluation impact are described
- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated

## RAG/evaluation impact

State the expected impact and evidence. Do not claim quality improvements without a reproducible dataset and baseline.
